chapter: Road bands: Hucklebuck Williams and Tiny Bradshaw
title: Redeeming himself and the torn-up notice
summary: Sam plays hard the next night, explains the reefer, and Paul tears up his notice.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: So I said damn, I done messed up again, man. You're a fool. And now I'm embarrassed and everything. So we get to the next town, I said man, I got to make--I got to make up for this somehow or way. And I don't know. So only thing I could think of--of doing that, man, was going and play my--play up some bass, man. Play some bass. I ain't never, you know.
And that's what I did, man. I went out there in that bar and played the shit out of 'Hucklebuck,' man. That bass was ringing all over. You know, in those days, man, you didn't have no amplifiers.

And shit. Man, I played so much bass that night til everybody in the band was turned around looking at me. And Paul, man, he's smiling, man. And so after the dance, you know, I put my bass back on the bus. And I went to my seat. And Paul said 'listen here. The band say I

ain't never heard you play. Well, you know, when you first joined the band, you came in this band say you never played like that before." I said "what I--I don't think I--I don't know if I did anything any different." He said "well listen. Do you have a problem or something?" I said, "no, I don't have no problem." He said, "do you--are you involved in any kind of drugs--any kind?" Said "man, I don't--I don't use no drugs." He said "what was the matter with you the other night." I say "well, I smoked a joint and it just took me out."

He said "you mean to tell me that's the only thing that happened to you--you smoked a reefer?" I said "yeah." He looked at the road manager. The road manager looked at him and he say--and they took the--they say "do you see this letter, here? This was your notice." And they say "rip" and tore it up. You know? They said "we was getting ready to send you back to Florida, man, soon as the next town."
"Cause we had--we was going to get in touch with New York and have somebody--a bass player meet us, man."
Say "we was getting ready to send you back, man." I said "man, I don't indulge in no drugs and don't

want to be around nobody." And so I told them that I smoked reefer. And then so everybody in the band say "me too." They say "that's what you get for being so gree dy." They say "you should have invited us." So that's how I got you know--that's how I came along into New York with that band.
